<div class="card-body">
'''Rebel Scout''' is a [[Light]] [[Character]] ([[Rebel]]) from [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">反乱軍偵察兵</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">能力値＞2の反乱軍かリーダーがいる隣接した位置に対してリアクションとしてフォースを消費せずに移動できる。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Rebel-Scout-PSA-89232342.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">ヴィルダー・ブリンは典型的な反乱軍偵察兵で、前線偵察がその任務だ。即時対応戦術の訓練を受けており、多くは反乱軍に参加する以前に特殊部隊で経験を積んでいる。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Rebel Scout.

'''Card text:'''
You may move as a react without spending Force to an adjacent location where you have a Rebel with ability greater than 2 or a leader.

'''Lore:'''
Vildar Blin is a typical Rebel scout, and front-line reconnaissance is his assignment. Trained in first-response tactics, many gained special-forces experience before joining the Rebellion.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Japanese does not say the react is to a battle.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Rebel Scout]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
